# The Pet's Butler

> Pet sitting, dog walking and house visits in Centurion and Gauteng, South Africa. Founded by Rudi Beukes in 1997.

The Pet's Butler is a family-style pet-care business based in The Reeds, Centurion, serving clients in Centurion, Pretoria, Johannesburg and surrounding Gauteng communities. New service inquiries are for Gauteng. Existing clients travelling outside Gauteng can use the client access option on the website.

## Services
- Day pet sitting
- Dog walking (currently fully booked; call for cancellations or future availability)
- House visits
- Overnight boarding / sleepovers (currently fully booked; call for cancellations or future availability)

The online shop is currently under reconstruction. The future collection is being planned around reward-sized training bites, single-ingredient treats, dental chews, lick mats, puzzle and sniff toys, treat pouches, poo bags, reflective walk gear, portable water bowls, car safety tethers and washable blankets. Treats are only provided with the pet owner's permission and instructions.
